faq.description: We've migrated 1,000+ WordPress sites. These are the real questions.
faq.cta: Still have questions? Talk to us

items.question: Will my client's SEO tank after migration?
items.answer: No. We preserve every URL, generate 301 redirects for changed slugs, migrate all meta tags and schema markup, and submit updated sitemaps. Most clients see SEO improvements within 30 days because their Core Web Vitals finally pass.

items.question: What about WooCommerce stores?
items.answer: We don't migrate WooCommerce stores. Akash Engine is for service businesses — dental clinics, law firms, restaurants, consultants. If it's primarily a store, stay on WooCommerce.

items.question: How is $0/month hosting actually possible?
items.answer: Every site deploys to Cloudflare Pages. Their free tier includes unlimited sites, unlimited bandwidth, global CDN, and automatic SSL. Cloudflare's business model is enterprise customers — your client's site costs them essentially nothing.

items.question: What CMS does the client get?
items.answer: emdash — a modern headless CMS built on Astro with a WordPress-familiar editing experience. Clients update text, images, and blog posts without calling you. It's what WordPress should have been in 2025.

items.question: What if it doesn't hit Lighthouse 90+?
items.answer: Full refund. No questions asked. We've never triggered this guarantee — our average is 94/100 — but it exists because we mean it.
